attributes.name: icon presence and role in cards/headings
attributes.definition: How small icons or decorative marker images are used to mark card headings or sit inside cards.

values.definition: A small square or icon image precedes or marks section headings.
Icons placed within card containers, typically uniform in size.
No icons used for this purpose.

attributes.name: icon size uniformity
attributes.definition: Whether icons are rendered at a consistent small size.

values.definition: All icons share the same small square dimensions.
Small icons arranged tightly together in a row.

attributes.name: payment icon display
attributes.definition: How payment method icons are presented.

values.definition: Payment icons shown in a tight single row.
Payment icons shown in another layout.
